description: POC: UI screenshot diagnosis — identify a clipped button in a Crucible-like dashboard mock.

image_fixture.notes: Mock dashboard with a RUN BENCHMARK button whose right edge is clipped by a side panel. Fixture lands after review.

questions.question: Look at this UI screenshot. Name the single most-clipped or overlapped UI element. Reply with the element name only.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for vision_ui_diagnosis rubric — model must identify a specific clipped UI element by name.

known_scoring_limitations: text_match_all looks for the literal phrase; a model that says 'the benchmark button' will fail. May need rubric judge for partial credit.
